_comment: 1. Copy this file and name it with the ISO 639-1 code (e.g. ko.json for Korean).
2. Fill in every value in your target language.
3. Place the file in one of these locations:
On macOS the support-dir is ~/Library/Application Support/JoyRead/JoyRead
In a dev checkout it is .joyread_support/ at the repo root.
settings_value remains canonical; native_name is shown in the dropdown.
IMPORTANT: The 'delete' keyword in dialog.type_delete_header and
dialog.type_delete_error must remain the literal English word 'delete'.
The confirmation input validator always checks for the English string.
Example: '「delete」と入力すると、削除を行います。'
